summary: Rows 42-47 are six consecutive canon rows adapting the close of the Holy Sword arc and the opening of the Epic Challenge arc: OUR chapters 147-170 (vols 17-18), ~3.5 chapters an episode, zero filler. Every row takes an anchor. Two structural facts drive the block. (1) CHAPTER SPACE: dragonquest.fandom numbers only the 348 mainline chapters contiguously, while OUR space (total 349 = en-WP's original-release volume list = the stored v1-v37 table = AniList = MangaUpdates) reserves slot 122 for the 番外編「勇者アバン」 printed at the back of tankobon vol 13 — so every fandom number N >= 122 is OUR N+1. Every value below is converted and stated; the Japanese 話 list (outatimes, 旧コミック版基準) runs 第1話-第348話 with the 番外編 unnumbered, and ja-WP's 「読切や番外編を除いて全343話」 = 348 minus the five 読切 chapters 1-5, which is exactly the same convention. Batch 17's eps 1-17 anchors all sit below the seam and need no repair. (2) The anime UN-CROSS-CUTS the manga twice: ep 42 opens on the remaining Lankarks-smithy pages of ch 147 before returning to ch 150 (both chapters split with ep 41), and ep 45 pulls Zaboera's imprisonment out of ch 166 and Chiu's nose boast out of ch 159 — neither fragment inflates an END (A4, running order). Ep 46 closes on a single page (p. 15) of ch 167 that ep 47 owns: A47, END stays 166 — the fandom's own ch-167 page credits only ep 47, which is the wiki distinguishing a scrap from the real splits it does credit on both sides (chs 147, 150, 157, 170).

annotations.note: The anime un-cross-cuts the manga's two parallel threads: chs 147 (ダイの剣) and 150 (暗黒の怒り) are each split across eps 41 and 42 (the fandom marks both '(partial)' on ep 41 and credits both episodes on each chapter page). Ep 42 OPENS on ch 147's remaining Lankarks-smithy pages — a non-adjacent relocated opener, so the START stays 150 (A10/A12).

Ch 157 (勇気ある撤退) is split across the two episodes: ep 43 takes its opening (Popp diving to search for Dai), ep 44 the remainder (Matoriv's flashback, the Garuda, Crocodine's Redemption Blast). Both sides are credited on the fandom's ch-157 page — a real split, not an A47 scrap.

Two fragments air out of running order in ep 45: Chiu's nose boast, cut from ep 44's ch-159 coverage, and the Zaboera-imprisonment pages of ch 166 pulled forward from ep 46's block (ep 46's own Manga-differences list records the move). Neither inflates the END (A4).
A47 — a single page (p. 15) of ch 167 closes the episode as its last shot; ep 47 STARTS on 167 and owns the chapter, so the END stays 166. The fandom's ch-167 page credits ep 47 only.

Faithfulness clause: the episode inserts studio-made connective scenes inside adapted chapters (Dai and Hyunckel before the Lon Beruk visit; Maam/Crocodine/Chiu shown travelling to their training sites; Leona asking to train; an added Avan flashback). Small added beats inside adapted material — noted, never weighed toward mixed.

Ch 170 (北の勇者) is split with ep 48: ep 47 introduces Nova and the Royal Guard's assault on the Romos finalists; ep 48 carries the chapter's bulk. Both episodes are credited on the fandom's ch-170 page.

structure.notes: CHAPTER SPACE (the finding that governs every number here). OUR space = 349 chapters: en-WP's 'List of ... volumes' original-release list, the stored v1-v37 boundary table, AniList (349) and MangaUpdates (latest_chapter 349; anime pin 'Vol 37, Chap 349 (2020)') all reserve slot 122 for the 番外編「勇者アバン」 printed at the back of tankobon vol 13. dragonquest.fandom numbers only the 348 mainline chapters contiguously, so FANDOM N (N >= 122) = OURS N+1 (fandom 122 決勝戦の異変 = ours 123). I verified the seam independently before the coordinator's ruling arrived and reach the same place: the Japanese per-volume 話 list at outatimes (旧コミック版基準) runs 第1話 デルパ！イルイル！（前編） to 第348話 さらば!!!愛する地上よ with the 番外編 sitting unnumbered at the end of vol 13, and ja-WP's 「読切や番外編を除いて全343話」 is the same convention (348 minus the five 読切 chapters 1-5). Below ch 122 the two spaces are identical, so batch 17's eps 1-17 anchors (chs 1-60) are entirely below the seam and need NO repair; outatimes independently reproduces our stored v1 1-9, v2 10-18, v3 19-27, v6 48-56, v7 57-66. Above the seam the fandom's per-chapter |volume= field agrees with OUR stored boundaries only under the +1 (fandom ch 151 死の大地 -> vol 17; ours 152 is in v17 152-161, while an unconverted 151 would fall in v16) — checked at three boundaries (151/152, 161/162, 170/171). SOURCE INDEPENDENCE (flag #929): the fandom's forward (episode |adapted=) and reverse (chapter |adapted=) fields are ONE wiki and agree on all 24 chapters in this block; independence rests on outatimes' Japanese 話 list (chapter number -> title -> volume -> key events, converted +1), en-WP's volume list (OUR space, chapter titles + boundaries) and ja-WP (row identity). Every anchor here carries a title-namesake or debut-cast match from those sources: ep 42 = ch 152's title, ep 43 = ch 156's title, ep 44 = ch 158's title, ep 45 = ch 163's Royal-Guard debut cast, ep 46 = chs 165-166's Medroa acquisition, ep 47 = ch 167's title. No licensor per-episode synopsis survives: dq-dai.com's story pages are gone (the site keeps only /onair/, /about/, /character/) and no /story/ snapshot exists on the Wayback Machine; Bandai Channel and dAnime serve no readable per-episode description to a fetcher. Toei's per-episode summary pages (toei-anim.co.jp/tv/dq-dai/episode/summary/NN/) exist but carry plot prose only, no chapter claim.

flags_for_sean: CHAPTER SPACE, series-wide (affects the other six wave-13 sub-blocks, not this one alone): OUR space counts the 番外編「勇者アバン」 as ch 122, dragonquest.fandom does not. Every fandom chapter number >= 122 must be +1 before it lands. The seam is at ep ~35 (fandom ch 122 決勝戦の異変 is in ep 35), so sub-blocks a/b (eps 18-29) are unaffected, c (30-35) straddles the seam, and d/e/f/g (36-59) are entirely above it. A sub-block delivered in raw fandom numbers would be one chapter low for every row above the seam. My six rows are converted.

ep 42 START is a judgment call: the episode's FIRST animated pages are ch 147's remainder (the Lankarks smithy), but ch 147 is not start-1, so under A10's stated boundary ('only a partial of start-1 counts; a far-earlier chapter opening the episode is a relocated graft and never the position' — the AoT ep 87 precedent) I set START 150, where ep 41 stopped, and recorded the ch-147 opener in chapters_adapted with a `rearranged` annotation. The alternative reading (START 147, a bleach 152-159 style back-jump) is defensible; the END is unaffected either way.

ep 45 END is 163, not 166: the ch-166 pages ep 45 carries (Zaboera's imprisonment) are pulled FORWARD out of running order, and ep 46 adapts ch 166 proper. These pages air only in ep 45 (ep 46's Manga-differences list says the scene 'was moved to the previous episode'), so under 'pages, not numbers' they are real first-time pages — but they are not a running-order position, so they are annotated rather than anchored. If Sean prefers the 'pages, not numbers' reading to carry the END here, ep 45 would be 166 and would then plateau with ep 46.

A47 fired once (ep 46, the one-page ch-167 tail) and was tested and refused twice (ep 43 on ch 157, ep 47 on ch 170). The discriminator I used is the fandom's own reverse field: it credits BOTH episodes on a real split and only the owning episode on a scrap. That is a wiki convention, not a page count — if Sean wants page-level proof on eps 43 and 47, the raws would settle it; no source gives page numbers for those two.

MangaUpdates' pin for the 2020 anime is 'Vol 37, Chap 349' and its latest_chapter is 349 — both in OUR space, so the wave-14 ep-100 pin does not carry an edition problem; the honest question there is only whether ep 100 reaches ch 349 (the Japanese 話 numbering's 第348話 さらば!!!愛する地上よ).
